installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# PotenFYR Studios - Multi-Shell Universal Installer
if [ -d /mnt/server ]; then
    cd /mnt/server || exit 1
elif [ -d /home/container ]; then
    cd /home/container || exit 1
else
    cd "$(pwd)" || exit 1
fi
SERVER_DIR="$(pwd)"

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/logs" "${SERVER_DIR}/payloads" "${SERVER_DIR}/bin" "${SERVER_DIR}/.ssh-pub"

# A .git directory means SOURCE CHECKOUT - never self-clean there.
if [ ! -d "${SERVER_DIR}/.git" ]; then
for _f in "${SERVER_DIR}/run.sh" "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh"; do
    if [ -f "${_f}" ] && grep -q "PotenFYR Studios" "${_f}" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "${_f}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
done
unset _f
if [ -d "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts" ]; then
    _managed=1
    for _sf in "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts"/* "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts"/.*; do
        [ -e "${_sf}" ] || continue
        case "${_sf}" in
            */.|*/..) continue ;;
            *.sh|*.py) grep -q "PotenFYR Studios" "${_sf}" 2>/dev/null || _managed=0 ;;
            *) _managed=0 ;;
        esac
    done
    if [ "${_managed}" = "1" ]; then
        rm -rf "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts" 2>/dev/null || true
    else
        echo "[install] Keeping ./scripts - contains non-runtime (user) files."
    fi
    unset _managed _sf
fi
fi

# Sync runtime files from the egg repo (self-hosted runners copy them in).
if [ -n "${GIT_SOURCE_SYNC:-}" ]; then
    echo "[install] GIT_SOURCE_SYNC set - runtime files provided by image/sync."
fi

echo "[install] Multi-Shell egg workspace ready."
echo "[install] Credentials are the only mandatory setting."
echo "[install] SHELL_TYPE=auto shows an interactive picker on first boot."

variables.name: Shell Type
variables.description:
Which shell(s) to run. 'auto' opens an interactive paginated picker in the console on first boot. Otherwise a comma-separated list of ids:
server: ssh, ssh-cert, ssh-hardened, dropbear, telnetd, mosh-server
tunnel: ssh-local, ssh-remote, ssh-dynamic, ssh-x11, rsync-ssh, sshfs
reverse: bash-tcp, bash-udp, python, python-pty, php, php-pentest, perl, ruby, lua, node, powershell, golang, groovy, java, awk, nc, nc-udp, ncat, socat, cryptcat
secure: openssl-rs, socat-tls, ncat-ssl, wssh, dnscat, icmp-shell
bind: nc-bind, socat-bind, openssl-bind, php-bind, python-bind
web: ttyd, gotty, php-webshell, node-webshell
debug: ssh-debug, strace-shell, tcpdump-shell, socat-probe
See SHELLs.md for the full reference with connection examples.

variables.name: Shell Usernames
variables.description: MANDATORY in practice: comma-separated login users created inside the container (e.g. 'alice,bob'). Each gets a private home + bash. Invalid names are skipped with a warning.

variables.name: Shell User Passwords
variables.description: Positionally matched to Shell Usernames ('S3cretA,S3cretB'). Empty or 'auto' slots generate cryptographically random secrets (recorded in .env and .sh-users/credentials, mode 600, shown once in console).

variables.name: Extra Shell Types
variables.description: OPTIONAL: additional shell ids to run alongside the primary (same catalog as Shell Type). Example: 'socat,tmux' to also run a socat reverse shell and a tmux session.

variables.name: Extra Ports
variables.description: OPTIONAL: comma-separated extra panel ports for additional PORTED shells (the primary shell always binds this server's default port). Positionally matched to Extra Shell Types order. Reverse shells and multiplexers need no port.

variables.name: Reverse Target Host
variables.description: OPTIONAL: where reverse shells connect OUT to (your public IP / listener host). Required only when running reverse shells.

variables.name: Reverse Target Port
variables.description: OPTIONAL: port of your listener (nc -lvnp). Default 4444.

variables.name: TLS Reverse Shells
variables.description: OPTIONAL: 1 = TLS-capable reverse profiles (ncat, socat) wrap the channel with TLS when both sides support it.

variables.name: SSH Public Key
variables.description: OPTIONAL: your public key (one line, e.g. ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment). Installed into authorized_keys; the ONLY way in for the ssh-hardened profile.

variables.name: SSH Password Auth
variables.description: OPTIONAL: yes/no for the standard ssh + ssh-cert profiles (ssh-hardened is always keys-only).

variables.name: MOSH UDP Start Port
variables.description: OPTIONAL: first UDP port for Mosh roaming (opens SHELL_MOSH_UDP_COUNT ports downward range). Default 60000.

variables.name: Web Shell User
variables.description: OPTIONAL: basic-auth user for ttyd/gotty web terminals (password below). Empty = first generated credential is used.

variables.name: Web Shell Password
variables.description: OPTIONAL: basic-auth password for ttyd/gotty.

variables.name: Web Shell Token
variables.description: OPTIONAL: bearer token for php/node web shells (auto-generated when empty, shown once in console).

variables.name: MOTD Banner
variables.description: OPTIONAL: message shown on every shell login.
variables.default_value: Welcome to the Multi-Shell Universal Egg (PotenFYR Studios).

variables.name: Multiplexer Session Name
variables.description: OPTIONAL: tmux/screen session name. Default 'shell-eggs'.

variables.name: Default Login Multiplexer
variables.description: OPTIONAL: tmux|screen - drop SSH/Telnet logins straight into the persistent session.

variables.name: Show Credentials in Console
variables.description: OPTIONAL: 1 = print generated credentials on the boot console (they are always written to .env and .sh-users/credentials, mode 600).

variables.name: Auto Generate Credentials
variables.description: 1 = generate crypto-random secrets for empty/'auto' password slots and persist them. Credentials are the one mandatory input of this egg - everything else is optional.

variables.name: Panel Stop Watcher
variables.description: Watch console stdin for stop commands ('stop', '^C', 'exit', ...) delivered as text by TTY daemons. auto = on for all consoles; 0 = disable; 1 = force on.

variables.name: Console Theme
variables.description: Console output style. 'sh' = agent theme (</> shell-eggs prefixes); 'classic' = [PotenFYR] bracket style.

variables.name: Banner Gradient
variables.description: Boot banner gradient: auto (random per boot), aurora, candy, citrus, forest, sunset, ocean, or none.

variables.name: Egg Update URL
variables.description: Check on startup and self-update the launcher when the upstream egg changed (raw GitHub egg JSON or entrypoint URL).

variables.name: Auto Update Egg
variables.description: 1 = check EGG_UPDATE_URL on startup and self-update. 0 = disable the check entirely.
